10 استجازهُ He asked, or demanded, of him permission. (K, * TA.) ―
-b2- He asked, or demanded, of him [the authority or degree of a licentiate; i. e.,] a license with respect to the matters that he had related and heard [from other learned men, to teach the same]. (TA.) [See 4.] ＝
-A2- (tropical:) He asked, or demanded, of him (S, K) water for, (S,) or to water [for him], (K,) his land, or his beasts. (S, K.) ＝
-A3- He approved it. (Har p. 326.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
